title: How to register a paid expense
summary: Use financial record when the church already paid and cash has moved.
steps: Open Register financial record
Select the availability account used for payment
Choose the matching financial concept
Add cost center if the concept is an outgoing movement
Attach voucher if available and save

title: How to register a received contribution
summary: When treasury already received the money, register it as a financial record using an existing income concept. Use contributions list only for online or member-submitted contribution review.
steps: Open Register financial record
Fill date and amount of the received contribution
Select the availability account where the money entered
Choose an existing income financial concept that matches the contribution, such as the configured concept for tithe, offering, primicia or another recurring contribution
Save the record; if no suitable concept exists, review financial concepts before posting

title: How to review a submitted contribution
summary: Use the contributions list to review online or member-submitted contributions, inspect the receipt and approve or reject the submission.
steps: Open Contributions list
Filter by status or member if needed
Open the contribution detail to review member, concept, account and receipt
Approve the contribution when it is valid or reject it when the submission is incorrect

title: How to register a pending bill
summary: Use accounts payable when the obligation exists but has not been paid yet.
steps: Open Create account payable
Select or create supplier
Define installments and due dates
Select the financial concept
Save the commitment and pay it later from accounts payable

title: How to create a new financial concept
summary: Create a concept only when no existing concept matches the scenario.
steps: Review the current concepts list first
Open Create financial concept
Define type and statement category
Explain the use case in name and description
Save and reuse the concept in future movements

title: How to register a church asset
summary: Use patrimony when the church needs to track a durable good such as equipment, furniture, instruments or other assets.
steps: Open the patrimony asset form
Fill in the asset name, category and acquisition data
Set value, quantity, location and responsible person if applicable
Attach supporting files if available
Save the asset so it can be tracked, inventoried or disposed later

title: How to reconcile bank statements
summary: Use the banking module to import statements and review pending, unmatched or reconciled movements.
steps: Open bank reconciliation
Import the statement file when needed
Review pending and unmatched movements
Compare statement movements against existing records
Resolve unmatched items before considering the reconciliation complete

title: How to configure an availability account
summary: Create or review the accounts where the church keeps money available for financial postings.
steps: Open the availability account form
Define the account type and identifying information
Save the account and use it later in financial records
Review whether the account should be active before using it

title: How to configure a bank
summary: Use bank configuration before reconciliation or banking flows that depend on bank setup.
steps: Open the bank form
Fill in bank identity and account details
Save the bank and keep it active for later use
Return to banking or financial flows once the bank exists

title: How to configure a cost center
summary: Create cost centers to classify outgoing records by ministry, project or area.
steps: Open the cost center form
Define code, name and category
Assign responsible person when applicable
Save and reuse the center in outgoing records

title: How to register a purchase
summary: Use the purchases module when supplier, invoice and itemized purchase control matter.
steps: Open Register purchase
Select or create the supplier when needed
Fill the purchase date and financial context
Add each purchased item
Attach invoice or supporting document and save

title: How to register a supplier
summary: Create the supplier first when purchase or payable flows require a supplier that does not yet exist.
steps: Open the supplier form
Fill the supplier identification data
Save the supplier
Return to purchase or payable flow and select the created supplier

title: How to register an internal transfer
summary: Use internal transfer when money moves between church availability accounts and should not be treated as income or expense.
steps: Open Create internal transfer
Select the origin and destination availability accounts
Fill the transfer amount and date
Save the transfer without creating a normal income or expense record

title: How to review financial month status
summary: Use financial months to confirm whether the accounting period is open before trying to register or adjust movements.
steps: Open Financial months
Review whether the target month is open, closed or reopened
If the period is closed, resolve reopening or administrative action before posting

title: How to review church profile configuration
summary: Use church profile when the user needs institutional or profile-level configuration rather than treasury setup.
steps: Open Church profile
Review institutional data and configured profile information
Save the changes before returning to the operational flow

title: How to settle a payable already registered
summary: Use the payable detail and settlement flow when the debt was already created and now needs payment follow-up.
steps: Open Accounts payable list
Find the payable and open its detail
Review installment, supplier and due date before settling
Apply the payment through the payable flow instead of creating a disconnected new expense

title: How to collect an existing receivable
summary: Use the receivable detail when the future income already exists and the church is now applying a collection.
steps: Open Accounts receivable list
Find the receivable and open its detail
Review debtor, installment schedule and pending balance
Apply or confirm the collection using the receivable flow before creating a disconnected new receipt

title: How to support member commitments
summary: Use member commitments when the question belongs to the member-side commitment flow rather than treasury registration.
steps: Open Member commitments
Review the commitment status and pending information
Confirm or guide the member flow from there instead of creating a treasury posting

title: How to analyze a report with Gloria Assistance
summary: Run the report first and then open Gloria Assistance from the report screen to analyze the emitted payload.
steps: Open the report screen and generate the report
Use the analyze action available in that report
Review the executive summary, attention points and suggested follow-up

title: How to register benevolence or targeted assistance
summary: Use a direct financial record only when the church already delivered the aid and the money has already left treasury.
steps: Confirm that the aid was already paid from cash or bank
Open Register financial record
Choose the outgoing concept for benevolence or assistance if it already exists
Select the availability account that actually funded the aid
Add supporting notes or voucher and save the posting

title: How to register a payment to a guest minister or musician
summary: First confirm whether the payment belongs to a specific event, a ministry transfer or a non-recurring support case, then register it in the correct financial flow.
steps: Confirm that the payment was already made and treasury cash already moved
Open Register financial record
Review whether an event-related, ministry-transfer or guest-payment concept already exists
Choose the availability account used for the payment and save the record

title: How to register money the church expects to recover later
summary: Use accounts receivable when the church expects collection later instead of posting the case as a normal donation or treasury receipt.
steps: Open Create account receivable
Register the debtor or expected payer
Define installments, due dates and the matching concept
Save the receivable and use the collection flow later when money comes in

title: How to proceed when the financial month is closed
summary: Review the financial month status before trying to force the posting in another operational flow.
steps: Open Financial months
Confirm whether the target period is closed
If needed, request reopening or administrative action before posting the movement

title: How to handle money received as a loan
summary: When the church receives money that must be repaid later, do not treat it as a normal contribution or offering.
steps: Confirm whether the case creates an obligation that the church must repay later
If it is a real debt, review the payable or controlled commitment flow before using a normal income registration
Use direct treasury registration only when the configured concept and accounting policy explicitly support that borrowed-money entry

title: How to proceed with a partial payment or collection
summary: When the church is paying or collecting only part of an existing commitment, continue the original payable or receivable flow instead of creating a disconnected new posting.
steps: Identify whether the church already created a payable or receivable for that obligation
Open the original commitment and review the remaining balance
Apply the partial settlement in that same flow instead of registering a disconnected direct movement
